findings.summary: summarize() iterates the read_rows generator twice (any() pre-check then a for loop), so the generator is partly or fully consumed and total, by_actor and high are undercounted, which can make quiet wrongly report no high-severity events.

judge.reason: Identifies the double iteration of the one-shot generator in summarize (any() then loop) causing missing high events.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The laziness test never closes the generator, leaving the file handle open until garbage collection.

judge.reason: Unclosed generator in a test is a minor test hygiene issue, not a defect in the changed behavior.

findings.label: false_alarm
